Game Overview

In Golem Survival, the core idea is straightforward: dive into a colorful world where every corner holds danger and riches. In Golem Survival, armed with only a blade, you must skillfully navigate through platforming challenges, outsmart gigantic golems, and collect gleaming coins. With increasing difficulty and vibrant visuals, every victory feels monumental.
